from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the collection with its title and links to other papers in the collection it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_collection_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of papers within the provided collection that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
